name: amp
description: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus is a serverless, Prometheus-compatible monitoring service for container metrics that makes it easier to securely monitor container environments at scale.

subcommands.name: create-alert-manager-definition
subcommands.description: The CreateAlertManagerDefinition operation creates the alert manager definition in a workspace.

subcommands.name: create-anomaly-detector
subcommands.description: Creates an anomaly detector within a workspace using the Random Cut Forest algorithm for time-series analysis.

subcommands.name: create-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: The CreateLoggingConfiguration operation creates rules and alerting logging configuration for the workspace.

subcommands.name: create-query-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a query logging configuration for the specified workspace.

subcommands.name: create-rule-groups-namespace
subcommands.description: The CreateRuleGroupsNamespace operation creates a rule groups namespace within a workspace.

subcommands.name: create-scraper
subcommands.description: Creates a scraper to collect metrics from Prometheus-compatible sources.

subcommands.name: create-workspace
subcommands.description: Creates a Prometheus workspace.

subcommands.name: delete-alert-manager-definition
subcommands.description: Deletes the alert manager definition from a workspace.

subcommands.name: delete-anomaly-detector
subcommands.description: Removes an anomaly detector from a workspace.

subcommands.name: delete-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the rules and alerting logging configuration for a workspace.

subcommands.name: delete-query-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the query logging configuration for the specified workspace.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource-based policy attached to an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace.

subcommands.name: delete-rule-groups-namespace
subcommands.description: Deletes one rule groups namespace and its associated rule groups definition.

subcommands.name: delete-scraper
subcommands.description: The DeleteScraper operation deletes one scraper, and stops any metrics collection that the scraper performs.

subcommands.name: delete-scraper-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the logging configuration for a Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus scraper.

subcommands.name: delete-workspace
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing workspace.

subcommands.name: describe-alert-manager-definition
subcommands.description: Retrieves the full information about the alert manager definition for a workspace.

subcommands.name: describe-anomaly-detector
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific anomaly detector, including its status and configuration.

subcommands.name: describe-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns complete information about the current rules and alerting logging configuration of the workspace.

subcommands.name: describe-query-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of the query logging configuration for the specified workspace.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Returns information about the resource-based policy attached to an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace.

subcommands.name: describe-rule-groups-namespace
subcommands.description: Returns complete information about one rule groups namespace.

subcommands.name: describe-scraper
subcommands.description: The DescribeScraper operation displays information about an existing scraper.

subcommands.name: describe-scraper-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Describes the logging configuration for a Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus scraper.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace
subcommands.description: Returns information about an existing workspace.

subcommands.name: describe-workspace-configuration
subcommands.description: Use this operation to return information about the configuration of a workspace.

subcommands.name: get-default-scraper-configuration
subcommands.description: The GetDefaultScraperConfiguration operation returns the default scraper configuration used when Amazon EKS creates a scraper for you.

subcommands.name: list-anomaly-detectors
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of anomaly detectors for a workspace with optional filtering by alias.

subcommands.name: list-rule-groups-namespaces
subcommands.description: Returns a list of rule groups namespaces in a workspace.

subcommands.name: list-scrapers
subcommands.description: The ListScrapers operation lists all of the scrapers in your account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: The ListTagsForResource operation returns the tags that are associated with an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus resource.

subcommands.name: list-workspaces
subcommands.description: Lists all of the Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspaces in your account.

subcommands.name: put-alert-manager-definition
subcommands.description: Updates an existing alert manager definition in a workspace.

subcommands.name: put-anomaly-detector
subcommands.description: When you call PutAnomalyDetector, the operation creates a new anomaly detector if one doesn't exist, or updates an existing one.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a resource-based policy for an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace.

subcommands.name: put-rule-groups-namespace
subcommands.description: Updates an existing rule groups namespace within a workspace.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: The TagResource operation associates tags with an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus resource.

subcommands.name: update-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the log group ARN or the workspace ID of the current rules and alerting logging configuration.

subcommands.name: update-query-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the query logging configuration for the specified workspace.

subcommands.name: update-scraper
subcommands.description: Updates an existing scraper.

subcommands.name: update-scraper-logging-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the logging configuration for a Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus scraper.

subcommands.name: update-workspace-alias
subcommands.description: Updates the alias of an existing workspace.

subcommands.name: update-workspace-configuration
subcommands.description: Use this operation to create or update the label sets, label set limits, and retention period of a workspace.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: anomaly-detector-active
subcommands.description: Wait until the anomaly detector reaches ACTIVE status It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: anomaly-detector-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until the anomaly detector reaches DELETED status It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: scraper-active
subcommands.description: Wait until a scraper reaches ACTIVE status It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: scraper-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until a scraper reaches DELETED status It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: workspace-active
subcommands.description: Wait until a workspace reaches ACTIVE status It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: workspace-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until a workspace reaches DELETED status It will poll every 2 seconds until a successful state has been reached.
